bookSourceComment:
BL小说（ifuwen 发布页镜像：bl-novel.com 等）。
【登录】网页登录（含验证码），右上角✓保存设置。
【登录页】👤登录 / 🔑退出 / 🔍检查登录 / 🌐检查域名 / 域名列表(select) / 💬交流分享群 / 🎨联系制作人。
【发现】📚BL/BG/GL分类 + 🏆评分/收藏/点击榜。
【正文】自动解密（webView + JS 解密，密钥在图片像素里）。前5章免费，第6章起需登录。
exploreUrl:
<js>
var result = [];
function push(t, u){ result.push({"title": t, "url": u, "style": {"layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.4}}); }
var base = 'https://{{source.get("base")||"bl-novel.com"}}';
var groups = ["分类", "时间", "排行", "标签"];
var tab = infoMap["发现分组"] || "分类";
result.push({"title": "发现分组", "type": "select", "chars": groups, "default": tab, "action": "java.refreshExplore()", "style": {"layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 1}});
if(tab == "分类"){
	push("📚 BL耽美", base + '/sort/1/{{page}}.html');
	push("📚 BG言情", base + '/sort/2/{{page}}.html');
	push("📚 GL百合", base + '/sort/3/{{page}}.html');
}else if(tab == "时间"){
	var sorts = [["BL","1"],["BG","2"],["GL","3"]];
	var times = [["今天","today"],["昨天","yesterday"],["7天","7days"],["30天","30days"]];
	for(var i=0;i<sorts.length;i++){
		for(var j=0;j<times.length;j++){
			push("🕒 " + sorts[i][0] + "·" + times[j][0], base + '/sort/' + sorts[i][1] + '/{{page}}-desc-' + times[j][1] + '.html');
		}
	}
}else if(tab == "排行"){
	var ranks = [["评分","score"],["点击","click"],["收藏","collect"]];
	var cats = [["全部",""],["BL","1"],["BG","2"],["GL","3"]];
	for(var i=0;i<ranks.length;i++){
		for(var j=0;j<cats.length;j++){
			push("🏆 " + ranks[i][0] + "榜·" + cats[j][0], base + '/ranking/?type=' + ranks[i][1] + '&days=all' + (cats[j][1] ? '&cat=' + cats[j][1] : '') + '&page={{page}}');
		}
	}
}else if(tab == "标签"){
	try{
		var lab = String(java.ajax(base + '/label/') || '');
		var re = /<a[^>]*href="\/label\/list\/(\d+)\/1\/"[^>]*data-tag-name="([^"]*)"[^>]*>/g;
		var m, cnt = 0;
		while((m = re.exec(lab)) && cnt < 15){
			var nm = m[2].replace(/ /g, ' ').trim();
			if(nm){ push("# " + nm, base + '/label/list/' + m[1] + '/{{page}}/'); cnt++; }
		}
	}catch(e){}
}
JSON.stringify(result);
</js>
